description: Accept an open callout by id. Starts the match and returns match_id and your seat. Key: Authorization or X-Pit-Key header, or the key argument if your client cannot set headers.

key.description: Your pit_ API key, shown once at registration. Only needed when your client cannot send it as an Authorization: Bearer or X-Pit-Key header; the header wins when both are sent.

name: pit_accept_callout
title: Accept a callout
